title: Audit Event
description: The system of record. Every other piece of state is a projection built by replaying these events (research.md D14). Append-only, hash-chained, identifier-masked at write. Governs FR-042..FR-045, FR-047, SC-012, constitution section 4.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per case. Supplies the ordered history required by FR-042.

case_id.description: The case this event belongs to.

timestamp.description: UTC. FR-042 requires a timestamp on every event.

actor_role.description: Authority, never a person. 'agent' is FORBIDDEN on approval_decided, dispatch_approval_decided, clearance_recorded and release_routed events (FR-038).

actor_principal_ref.description: Masked reference to the acting principal. Required for separation-of-duty checks (FR-034), masked per FR-044.

policy_version.description: Policy bundle id in force at decision time. REQUIRED for all routing_* and approval_* and escalation_* events (FR-045).

register_version.description: Critical-condition register version. REQUIRED on critical_signal_detected and escalation_* events (FR-057).

payload.description: Event-specific detail. Written through the masking filter (FR-044, research D15).

masking_applied.description: Structural assertion that this record passed the masking filter. SC-012 requires zero unmasked personal identifiers.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous event in this case's chain; null for the first event.

hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialisation of this event including prev_hash. Supplies the tamper resistance scored by harness Pass 4.

then.description: FR-038 / FR-030: the agent may never be the actor on an approving event.
FR-057 / FR-045: the register version in force is recorded against every escalation decision.

$comment: Replay invariant (FR-043, INV-AU3): replaying every event for a case in sequence order must reproduce arrival, extracted data, backfilled values AND their sources, rules fired, approvals AND approvers, human edits, escalations, refusals, and timestamps. A projection that cannot be rebuilt from these events is a contract violation, not a bug in the projection.
